class SpheroidPy.spheroid.spheroid_collection.SpheroidCollection(name: str, spheroid_list: list[SpheroidSeries] | None = None, result: Result | None = None, hdf5_path: str | None = None)[source]

Bases: object

Collection of spheroid series representing biological replicates.

Groups spheroids from the same experimental condition across different Results/replicates and provides methods for analysis.

name

Name of the condition this collection represents

replicate_dict

Maps dates to lists of spheroid series

replicate_metadata

Maps spheroid series names to replicate info

ignored_spheroids

Set of spheroid series names to exclude

time_periods

Maps time period names to (hours_start, hours_end) tuples

active_period

Currently active time period name

Raises:

add_time_period(name: str | None = None, *, relative: tuple[float, float] | None = None, absolute: dict[str, tuple[str | datetime, str | datetime]] | None = None)[source]

Add a named time period for analysis.

Parameters:

  • name – Name for the time period

  • relative – Optional (start_hours, end_hours) from replicate start

  • absolute – Optional dict mapping result_names to (start_date, end_date)

Example

# Relative time (24-48h from each replicate’s start) collection.add_time_period(“day2”, relative=(24, 48))

# Absolute dates (different for each result) collection.add_time_period(“phase1”, absolute={

‘Day1_Result’: (‘2024-01-01’, ‘2024-01-02’), ‘Day2_Result’: (‘2024-01-02’, ‘2024-01-03’)

})

class SpheroidPy.spheroid.spheroid_image.SpheroidImage(brightfield: Path | str, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: object

A class for analyzing and processing images of spheroids.

property area: float | None

Calculate the area enclosed by the spheroid contour.

Uses the shoelace formula to compute the area enclosed by the contour, scaled to physical units (μm²).

Returns:

Area in μm² if contour exists, None otherwise

brightfield() → ndarray[source]
diffusion_stationary(boundary_value: float = 10, diffusion_rate: float = 1000, reaction_rate: float = 0.1, plot: bool = True, plot_full: bool = True, accuracy: int = 10)[source]

Solve the stationary diffusion-reaction equation for the spheroid.

Solves ∇⋅(D∇c)-kc=0 using finite element method, where: - c is concentration - D is diffusion coefficient - k is reaction rate

Parameters:

  • boundary_value – Concentration at spheroid boundary

  • diffusion_rate – Diffusion coefficient in μm²/s

  • reaction_rate – Reaction rate in mol/μm²/s

  • plot – Whether to display solution plot

  • plot_full – Whether to show full solution field

  • accuracy – Mesh resolution parameter

Returns:

(points, triangles, solution) where:

points: Mesh vertex coordinates triangles: Mesh connectivity solution: Concentration values at mesh points

Return type:

tuple

fluorescence(color: str) → ndarray[source]
functional_radius(live_color: str | None = 'green', death_color: str | None = 'red') → dict[source]

Calculate functional radii based on fluorescence profiles.

Uses fluorescence intensity profiles to determine: - Outer radius (total spheroid size) - Inhibited radius (where cell growth is impaired) - Necrotic radius (where cells are dead/dying)

Parameters:

  • live_color – Color channel for live cell marker

  • death_color – Color channel for dead cell marker

Returns:

outer: Total spheroid radius in μm inhibited: Radius where growth inhibition begins necrotic: Radius where necrosis begins

Return type:

Dictionary containing

mesh(max_area: float = 500, plot: bool = True, accuracy: int = 1)[source]

Generate a triangular mesh of the spheroid contour.

Uses MeshPy to create a triangulation of the region enclosed by the contour.

Parameters:

  • max_area – Maximum allowed area for triangles in the mesh

  • plot – Whether to display a plot of the generated mesh

  • accuracy – Sample every nth point from contour for mesh generation

Returns:

(points, triangles) where points is an array of vertex coordinates and triangles is an array of triangle vertex indices

Return type:

tuple

Calculate fluorescence intensity metrics within the spheroid contour.

Parameters:

  • fluorescence_color – Color channel to analyze (‘green’, ‘red’, ‘blue’)

  • ignore_border – Whether to proceed if spheroid touches image border

Returns:

Tuple of (cumulative intensity, mean intensity) or (None, None) if invalid

radial_profile(plot: bool = True, angle_step: int = 2) → dict[source]

Calculate the radial intensity profile of the spheroid.

Measures fluorescence intensity along radial lines from the center to the boundary at regular angular intervals.

Parameters:

  • plot – Whether to display a plot of the profiles

  • angle_step – Angular step size in degrees between measurements

Returns:

mean_radius: Average radius of the spheroid intensity_profiles: Dictionary of normalized intensity profiles

for each fluorescence channel

Return type:

Dictionary containing

property radius: float | None

Calculate the effective radius of the spheroid.

Computes radius as r_eff = sqrt(Area/π), giving the radius of a circle with equivalent area to the spheroid.

Returns:

Effective radius in μm if valid contour exists, None otherwise

property scaled_contour: ndarray

Get the contour scaled to physical coordinates.

Converts contour from pixel coordinates to physical coordinates (μm) based on the image size.

Returns:

Array of shape (N,2) containing scaled (x,y) contour coordinates in μm

segmentation(segmentation: tuple = ('thresholding', 'fluorescence_green'), reconstruct_border: bool = True, border_margin: int = 5)[source]

Segment the spheroid using specified method and channel.

Parameters:

  • segmentation – Tuple of (method, channel) where method is either ‘thresholding’ or ‘ai’, and channel specifies which image to use

  • reconstruct_border – Whether to reconstruct spheroid border when it extends beyond image bounds

  • border_margin – Margin in pixels to use when detecting border contact

The segmentation result is stored in self.contour and self.contour_touches_border. If segmentation fails with the specified method, falls back to AI segmentation on brightfield image.

segmentation_detectron(channel: str, thres: float = 0.65)[source]

Segment spheroid using Detectron2 instance segmentation model.

Uses a pre-trained Mask R-CNN model to detect and segment the spheroid.

Parameters:

  • channel – Image channel to use for segmentation

  • thres – Detection confidence threshold

Returns:

(contour, touches_border) where contour is array of boundary points and touches_border indicates if spheroid extends beyond image bounds

Return type:

tuple
